command:
set -eu
test ! -e /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba
test -f /opt/odin-delivery/v3-d3e5505/job.exit
dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}\n' python-is-python3
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-0fe03ba.bundle -o /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba.bundle
printf '%s\n' 'a760cec2ecf064d80a801f18e11a6024cf9bf336124fc8f4a8386f1d5c687900  /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba.bundle' | sha256sum --check -
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json -o /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json
printf '%s\n' '260ba0d539ebf4ab9a3bc0df4ac21343348ca08d6769fb1606b3d98e2df3cbff  /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json' | sha256sum --check -
curl --fail --silent --show-error http://10.0.2.2:47652/run-linux-candidate-v5.py -o /opt/odin-transfer/run-linux-candidate-v5.py
printf '%s\n' '7403d0729ccbd30c45df38c9a67422ea36ba6bc82641939eee63d204cac05984  /opt/odin-transfer/run-linux-candidate-v5.py' | sha256sum --check -
runuser -u odin-qa -- git -C /opt/odin-final bundle verify /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba.bundle
install -d -o odin-qa -g odin-qa /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba /opt/odin-delivery/v3-0fe03ba
runuser -u odin-qa -- git clone --quiet /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba.bundle /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba
runuser -u odin-qa -- python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba')
manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json').read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()==manifest['revision']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=root)
for row in manifest['files']:
    content=(root/row['path']).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==row['sha256'] and len(content)==row['bytes'],row['path']
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','revision':manifest['revision'],'checked_files':len(manifest['files']),'clean':True}))
PY
nohup runuser -u odin-qa -- sh -c 'python3 /opt/odin-transfer/run-linux-candidate-v5.py --revision 0fe03ba30da9600c25588d506d7e094df89cf56f --tree /opt/odin-linux-0fe03ba --manifest /opt/odin-transfer/odin-0fe03ba-source-sha256.json --delivery /opt/odin-delivery/v3-0fe03ba; result=$?; printf "%s\n" "$result" > /opt/odin-delivery/v3-0fe03ba/job.exit; exit "$result"' > /opt/odin-delivery/v3-0fe03ba/job.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
printf 'LINUX_CORRECTED_CANDIDATE_JOB_PID=%s\n' "$!"
